tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /klu gtor bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo mañdzu gho ṣa ya/ rgyal kun thugs rje gcig bsdus pa/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes rab tu grags/ /gang de'i )zhabs la gus btud nas/ /klu gtor cho ga bya tshul bshad/ /de yang glu gtor gyi cho ga ji ltar bya ba'i tshul mkhas pa dag gis mdzad pa re gnyis snang yang*/ 'dir gzhan dag gi bskul ba la brten nas sngon la de dag gi bzhed pa phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs nas 'chad pa la gsum/ sngon tu ji ltar bya ba dang*/ dngos gzhi'i skor dang*/ mjug gi rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ras shog sogs kyi steng du dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba dang bcas pa la yi ge phu bris te mthar chu ris byas la mdun du stegs kyi khar dgod/ mchod pa gzhan dang snod du dkar gsum mngar gsum dang klu sman sna tshogs bsres pa'i ril bu dang chang bu gang rung bya zhing zlum gtor mdzad pa'ang snang*/ chu gtsang dang 'o ma bsres pa la klu sman btab dang*/ grub na rin po che dang 'bru sna dang dkar gsum mngar gsum dang klu sman rnams snod so sor bshams shing*/ snyugs ldem la dar dang tshon skud sogs kyis brgyan par bya'o/ /de nas rang nyid khrus dang gtsang sbra dang ldan pas sha chang sgog btsong sogs spangs te/ kha byang shar ram gzhan du phyogs par yang rung ngo*/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ bsngo tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ paṇa chen rin po ches spyan ras gzigs gang yang rung bas bya bar bshad la/ rgyal dbang lnga pas kha sar pā ṇi'i bdag bskyed mdzad cing*/ gzhan du seng ge'i sgra'i sgo nas bya bar bshad pas 'dir phyi ma ltar byas na khyad che bar bsams te/ de bzhin du bya ba'i sngon du skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs byas la/ /swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las pad+ma dmar po'i lte bar siṃ las seng ge dkar po'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du hrīṃḥyig dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/

de gnyis byas tshur 'dus/ hrīṃḥyig la thim de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun seng ge'i sgra sku mdog dkar po/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa gzhon nu dkar thub pa'i tshul 'dzin cing*/ ral pa'i cod paṇa can/ phyag g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon zla gdan la brten pa'i mtheb mdzub gnyis kyis pad ma'i rtsa ba nas bzung ste rtse mo gnyis su gyes pa'i steng du ye shes kyi ral gri dang*/ dri zhim po'i me tog gis bkang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa/ sku'i g.yas su sprul dkar po kha nas khrag 'dzag pas dkris pa'i rtse gsum zla ba la btsugs pa/ ras skud dmar po'i tshangs skud dang*/ ras bzang po'i sham thabs gsol zhing*/ sku las 'od zer lnga dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs 'phro ba/ zhabs dkyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan pa/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i seng ge'i sgra'i ye shes pa dang*/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ ye shes pa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes sogs ba btab pa/ de rnams kyis auṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa byin brlab bya ba ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du auṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ auṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ gis byin gyis brlabs la/ auṃ sing ha nā da sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha hūṃ swāhā/

nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos zhes sogs kyis bstod la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥyig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi nad dang sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs nas hrīḥyig la thim par gyur par bsams la/ auṃ āḥhrīḥsidha nā da hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa ci 'grub dang*/ gzungs ring bzlas na'ang legs/ mthar yig brgya dang mchod bstod sngar bzhin bya'o/ /de nas klu gtor gyi rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swabhū was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsis klu nad thams cad sel bar byed cing*/ 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i gter chen por gyur/ auṃ ā hūṃ/ lan gsum dang*/ rgyas par na sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin brlab bya zhing*/ bsdu na/ auṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ārtā ya ārtā ya hoḥbadz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum/ auṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ gi bar gyis byin brlab zhing*/ bdag gi bsam pa'i zhes sogs kyis bden stobs brjod do/ /gnyis pa mdun bskyed ni*/ amṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du rin po che'i brag gser gyi bya skyibs can gyi 'og tu/ mtsho dang rdzing bu/ ldeng ka chu mig khron pa/ 'bab chu/ ne'u gsing*/ spangs ljongs skyed tshal sogs dang bcas pa'i pho brang rin po che las grub pa'i nang du/ phuḥlas klu rgyal wa ru ṇas gtso byas pa'i klu chen brgyad stod mi'i rnam pa dang smad sbrul mjug can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ 'khor du klu gnyan sa bdag ma lus pa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros rgya mtsho chen po nas wa ru ṇa sogs klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/

'jig rten khams kyi klu gnyan sa bdag thams cad skad cig gis spyan drangs/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /sa 'og mun pa ma lus sel mdzad pa'i/ /bstan la rab dka' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal ma lus 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs/ /rgyal rigs rje rigs dmangs rigs dang*/ /bram ze gdol pa la sogs pa/ /klu gnyan sa bdag 'khor dang bcas/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /auṃ nā ga rā dza bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wa ra e h+ye hi badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ rang rang dgyes pa'i pad gdan la/ /bzhugs nas mchod tshogs bzhes su gsol/ /pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ gsum pa bsngo tshul la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ smon lam mo/ /dang po ni/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba yi/ /phyag sor rtse las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa/ /mchod pa'i tshogs dang lhan cig 'dres pa de/ /klu gnyan sa bdag kun tshim longs spyod gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas lag pa g.yas kyis mchod gtor gyi snod du chu rgyun sbreng zhing*/ g.yon pas se gol gdab la/ auṃ ba su ki maṃ swāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa brjod pa ni klu gtor kyi dngos gzhir bshad/ skabs 'dir paṇa chen rin po che'i de tsam ma gtogs sngags gzhan ma bshad la/ rgyal dbang lnga pa'i klu gtor cho ga de nas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba tat+khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga ṇa khaṃ swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ nā ga rā dzā sa pā wā ra a m-i ta u da ga pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ zhes pa lan mang du brjod par bshad de rgyas bsdus so/ /dpe gzhan zhig na 'dir klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya byas te/ auṃ hi li hi li ma hā hi li phrum phu swāhā/ zhes lan gsum dang se gol gdab cing*/ auṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha phrum su swāhā/ lan gsum gyis klu la gtor ma zur du bsngos na legs par bshad do/ /rgyal dbang gis skabs 'di nas smon lam gdab pa ma gtogs gzhan ma bshad cing*/

paṇa chan rin po ches 'di ltar bshad de/ klu tshogs kun gyi rjer gyur pa'i/ /gdengs ka nor bu'i 'od zer gyis/ /'dod rgu'i dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /wa ru ṇa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' yas dang ni 'jog po dang*/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang rigs ldan dang*/ /nor rgyas dang ni dung skyong dang*/ /pad ma dang ni chu lha dang*/ /dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo/ /rgya mtsho dang ni rgya mtsho che/ /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od chen dang*/ /gzugs chen sprul bzang stobs po che/ /klu yi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma bzhes/ /mdzes pa'i dkar gsum mchod pa dang*/ /mngar gsum 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'khyil/ /rin chen mdzes pa'i them skas can/ /klu yi sdug bsngal skyob byed pa'i/ /mthun pa'i rdzas su 'di gyur cig /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams dang*/ /klu las gyur pa'i nad kyi rigs/ /mthong ba'i dug dang reg pa'i dug /bsam ngan dug dang kha blangs dug /sbyor ba'i dug la sogs pa kun/ /ma lus myur du zhi gyur cig /bdag pas gces pa'i rdzas khyer la/ /klu yi nad rnams zhi bar mdzod/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub dang*/ /dpal 'byor longs spyod rgyas par mdzod/ /ces brjod cing 'phrin las bcol bar bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa smon lam ni/ kyai/ klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas sogs/ /sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod phul byas pas/ /tshim zhing dga' bas rgyas gyur cig /sman gyi rgyal po bzang drug gis/ /don snod nyams pa sos gyur cig /dzā ti gur gum bzang po yis/ /sha khrag mtshan nyams sos gyur cig /mgron bu dung dang dar dmar gyis/ /so rus lce nyams sos= /rma bya'i mdongs dang dar tshon lngas/ /gzi mdangs nyams pa sos= /snying mkhal gla gor sho sha yis/ /snying mkhal glo nad sos= /dbang lag chu srin sder mo yis/

/yan lag nyams pa sos= /su shas rtse dang rdo rgyus kyis/ /rtsa rgyus nyams pa sos= /dkar dmar tshal dang rin chen gzis/ /khrag mig nyams pa sos= /zin hun ras skud sbrul shun gyis/ /rtsa lpags nyams pa sos= /gzhan yang spang spos byi thang ka /sle tres thang lo snyug lo dang*/ /ut+pal rin chen 'bras bu gsum/ /thal kar rdo rje til dkar nag /rgya mtsho'i wu ba rgun 'brum dang*/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bru sman dris/ /sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad kyi/ /phung khams skye mched nyams pa sogs/ /nad rnams thams cad sos gyur cig /bang mdzod nyams pa gang gyur cig /so so'i re ba skong gyur cig /'jigs pa kun las thar gyur cig /tshe dpal bsod nams rgyas gyur cig /dgos rgu'i yo byad 'byor gyur cig /byams pa'i sems dang ldan gyur cig /rnal 'byor sbyin bdag 'khor bcas pa/ /gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor zhi gyur cig /'jig rten khams su char 'bebs shing*/ /lo tog rtsi bcud rgyas gyur cig /rang gzhan bsam pa'i don thams cad/ /yid bzhin du ni 'grub gyur cig /zhes pa dang*/ 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*/ /bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag 'byung*/ /chos rnams de ltar shes par gyis/ /chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*/ /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs/ /skar ma rab rib mar me dang*/ /zhes sogs kyi mjug tu/ rang gi lus la dpe long la/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /phan pa'i 'bras bu bde ba 'byung*/ /gnod pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung*/ /sa bon tsha ba rnam pa bzhis/ /'bras bu tsha ba skyed par 'gyur/ /sa bon mngar ba btab pa

las/ /'bras bu mngar ba skye bar 'gyur/ /dpe dang bcas pa'i chos bshad pa/ /khyed rnams kyis ni shes par gyis/ /zhes brjod/ de nas klu'i sdig pa sbyong ba'i ched du mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs lan bdun nam gsum brjod de/ 'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /klu gnyan sa bdag thams cad kyis/ /nad dang sdug bsngal 'jigs zhi nas/ /bde skyid dpal la longs spyod shog /ngan song gnas las thar gyur te/ /lha mi'i lus rten mchog thob nas/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i skal ldan cing*/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob gyur cig /de nas/ rmad byung sras bcas sogs bsngo smon ci rigs bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ de ltar dngos su bshams pa dang*/ /yid kyi sprul ba las byung ba'i/ /mchod gtor klu sman sna tshogs kyis/ /klu gnyan sa bdag khyed rnams la/ /mchod pa'i skabs 'dir ma 'byor zhing*/ /nyams pa sogs kyis khyed rnams ni/ /dgyes pa bskyed par ma gyur dang*/ /phog thug nongs pa'i nyes pa kun/ /bzod par bzhes nas dgyes bzhin du/ /rang rang so so'i gnas gshegs mdzod/ /badz+ra muḥ nā ga rā dzā sa pā ri wa ra sarba gats+tsha/ khyung gi phyag rgya byas te/ gal te mi 'gro ba yong na/ auṃ ga ru ṭa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le swāhā/ klu gnyan sa bdag thams cad rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces brjod tshar mang du gtong bar 'dod na/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba yi/ /zhes pa nas/ khyed rnams kyis ni shes par gyis/ /zhes pa'i bar zlos nas bya'o/ /gong du bshad pa de spyi bcos gtso che la/ /gal te sger bcos zur du byed na/ klu gnyan gyi gzugs bcos nas snod dang shing leb sogs kyi steng du bzhag la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ sby-in pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag gang yin pa gang na gnas kyang 'dir bkug te/ gzugs brnyan 'di nyid la thim par gyur/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ

de dngos gnas su mos nas klu dbang dang spyan ras gzigs sed+ge'i sgra'i gzungs ring thung gnyis ka mang du bzlas pa'i bum chu sogs dang*/ klu sman 'o ma sogs gzugs brnyan de la gtor bzhin par klu gnyan sa bdag la gnod par gyur pa'i nad thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /ces mang du brjod/ grub na de dag gtor bzhin par/ /auṃ ru ru spu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dha lo tsā ni sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swāhā/ dang*/ auṃ de bya a mṛ ta nan tar bhi sha li te pra tits+tsha ba sa nan na ma swāhā/ zhes pa gnyis ci 'grub dang*/ auṃ sarba nā ga bhu mi pa ti byā dhi duḥkha pra sha ma na ye swāhā/ zhes pa rnams brjod cing*/ mthar gshegs te gzugs brnyan de chu bor 'dor ba'am/ bya khyi sogs kyis mi za ba'i gnas zhig tu bskyel lo// //༈ klu gtor gtong ba'i tshe/ klu thebs yod med lta ba'i srol 'dug pa ltar lta na/ paṇa chen rin po ches mdzad zer ba zhig las/ hor zla dang po'i tshes brgyad/ tshes dgu bcu bzhi/ bcu drug nyer lnga rnams klu thebs/ 7 de bzhin du hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bdun/ tshes bcu/ bcu gsum/ nyer gcig rnams dang*/ 7 gsum pa'i tshes lnga/ bcu bzhi/ nyer gnyis/ nyer lnga rnams dang*/ 7 bzhi pa'i bcu bzhi/ bcu drug /nyer gsum/ nyer lnga/ gnam gang rnams dang*/ 7 lnga pa'i tshes gcig /tshes bdun/ bcu dgu /nyer gsum/ nyer lnga rnams dang*/ 7 drug pa'i bcwo brgyad/ nyer lnga/ nyer dgu /gnam gang rnams dang*/ 7 bdun pa'i tshes gcig /bcu gcig /bcu drug /nyer gcig /nyer gsum/ nyer dgu rnams dang*/ 7 brgyad pa'i tshes gnyis/ tshes brgyad/ bcu gnyis/ nyer bdun/ nyer dgu rnams dang*/ 7 dgu pa'i tshes gnyis/ bcu gnyis/ bcu bdun rnams dang*/ 7 bcu pa'i nang du klu nyal bas thebs ldog gnyis ka med/ 7 bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig tshes dgu /bcu bzhi/ nyer gcig rnams dang*/ 7 bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gnyis/ tshes brgyad/ bcu drug bcu bdun/

bcu dgu rnams la klu thebs pas/ klu gtor btang na legs par bshad cing*/ klu ldog pa'i dus su mi gtong bar bshad kyang nad pa'i ched yin na nam btang yang chog go /ces pa 'di ni/ dad ldan gzhan gyis bskul ba ltar/ shāka btsun bshad sgrub ming can gyis bgyis shing*/ bar du rko ba po ni 'khyil chen sngags 'chang dad ldan bskal bzang rgya mtsho ste gzhan la phan thobapar gyur cig /par gyi yi ge pa ni 'khyil chen tshe dbang rgya mtsho'o/ /mad+ga laṃ/ bkra shis/ shu baṃ/ /
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/klu gtor bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bzhugs/ -PAGE 226--PAGE 227--PAGE 218-
